correctness.rationale: Full independent face enumerations agree at n=3..6. All 772 deterministic paired Hasse edges (12+51+165+544) are validated and all four entire directed cover diagrams topologically sorted to certify acyclicity. Critical-cell numbers are exact; primitive integral Morse boundaries are proved with an explicit determinant -1 3x3 maximal minor at n=5 and a coefficient +1 at n=6. For CW skeleta wedges of spheres in one dimension, their attaching maps are classified by integral degree, hence elementary homotopy cancellation yields exactly the claimed n=5 and n=6 wedge types. Complete independent F2 boundary ranks and Euler characteristics agree, but are not mistaken for integral proof. Proof and reproducible verifier embedded.

value.rationale: This finite classification directly addresses the ordinary matching-complex direction of Agarwal–Basak Problem 26 and distinguishes all-matchings topology from its contractible perfect-matching subcomplex on the pentagonal prism. The first mixed-dimensional integral homotopy type at n=5 and return to a single-dimensional wedge at n=6 are intrinsically motivated topological transitions in the canonical cyclic prism family; baseline n=3/4 locates the boundary. No arbitrary parameter slice, general theorem, or downstream application is asserted.
